The '''Pansat Mountain Range''' was located on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range's tallest peak was [[Aygion Mountain (mountain)|Aygion Mountain]], which was over twelve [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in height. Kinyen's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] believed that Aygion Mountain was their ancestral homeland and built their [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], also named [[Aygion Mountain]], on its slopes.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pansat Mountain Range was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
